memories.name: Black Bart's Gambit
memories.objective: Help Roberts take a Portuguese treasure ship by stealing a flag for a disguise, tailing the ship ashore, assassinating its captain and winning the naval battle.
steps: Sail southwest to 85,90 in the Serranilla region and dock beside Roberts' ship, the Princess.
Go with Roberts to the Portuguese ship at 70,54 (the winding route rules out Pathfinder).
Spyglass the ship, wait until the crew is busy talking, then swim to its western side.
Wait for the patrolling guard to turn away, climb the ropes, take out the gunner and the guard, then cut down the flag.
Sail southeast past a cluster of boats, then east to the Nosso Senhor, and go ashore for the chest Roberts wants.
Approach the beach from the south through reeds and bushes, bypass the guards via the southeast gap, loot the chest, then climb the watchtower and take out its guard.
Tail the Nosso Senhor unseen and clear the watchtowers at each stop (fire-side guards, a bell to sabotage, a small cave with guards, a heavier camp tower).
Board the Nosso Senhor from the north, climb the ropes and leap onto the captain to assassinate him.
Ram the small escort ships, then take on at least two Frigates one at a time, repairing on a defeated ship if needed. Beating both ends the mission.
tips: Wait for crew distractions and patrol turns before moving.
Use reeds and bushes for cover.
A defeated ship can be used to repair the Jackdaw.
gaps: Captain's name, enemy counts and full escort list not given.

memories.name: Murder and Mayhem
memories.objective: Hunt down Hornigold, first at sea in his ship the Benjamin, then on foot among cliff ruins on Santanillas.
steps: Travel north to the Chinchorro region near 145,179 where Roberts waits.
Find the Benjamin at 236,206; open with Mortars, close in and focus fire on it alone.
Land on Santanillas heading south; take the lone left guard, then the two under a rock.
Continue south past the rock to a Mayan Stelae puzzle (cannot be solved now).
Clear a few more guards and head to the southwest cliff ruins where Hornigold and a Viewpoint are.
Climb the wall near the Viewpoint to set up the assassination.
If Hornigold spots you, duel him: parry on blue flashes, dodge on red flashes, watch for telegraphed pistol shots.
Defeat him to finish and unlock Benjamin Sails for the Jackdaw.
optional: Longer east-side route with extra collectibles: a Data File, a treasure map on a skeleton, a beach chest, guarded chests.
Sync the Viewpoint (can still be done at the end if missed).
tips: Use Mortars first and ignore the other ships.
Come back later for the Stelae puzzle.
gaps: Hornigold's health or fight length not given.

memories.name: The Observatory
memories.objective: Follow Roberts and Adewale to the Observatory, learn its real purpose, then escape alone.
steps: Sail to the Charlotte region near 489,232 where Roberts waits (avoid mines and markers if the Sequence 5 fort is uncleared).
Follow Adewale into Long Bay, head southeast to a waterfall, then north via treetops and platforms to avoid wildlife.
Continue east past the bodies on the beach; a Viewpoint sits at the northern end.
Go on alone east of the bodies, under a rock, to a waterfall and a cave full of enemies.
Climb to the cave top for an alcove chest and wait out patrols while moving deeper.
Take out the upper-ledge guard, cross the treetops, knock out the guard by the cooking pot and head north.
Cross the bridge by the second waterfall, knock out one more patrol and loot another chest; the path turns southwest.
Follow Roberts southwest to the Observatory and place the chest he gives you, which turns the mission into a solo escape.
Escape by climbing stone blocks, heading north, scaling debris to a right-hand wall, back-ejecting to the wall behind and going round to a final climb in the northwest.
Follow the path north to face the group outside; the sequence then jumps to Edward in Port Royal, 1720.
optional: Detour southeast to sync a Viewpoint; a Data File and Mayan Stelae lie in the southwest corner nearby.
tips: Use treetop routes to avoid wildlife.
gaps: Details of the reveal and of the group outside not given.
Not stated whether the Viewpoints count toward full sync.
